title: Remediation job error messages and their ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE reasons, grouped by what they report
aliases: script execution blocked by execution policy
workflow expired before it could start

prose.text: These are the error messages a Remediation job reports, each with an internal ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE reason; Remediation itself is in [[zdx.remediation]]. The reasons below drop the ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE_ prefix.

prose.label: Table anomalies.
prose.text: Several rows of the published table read inconsistently {{gap:table-anomalies}}.

timing-errors.statement: Workflow timing errors: INTERNAL_ERR is an unexpected internal error (no action required); EXECUTION_TIMEOUT means the Remediation job reached its expiration and cannot run anymore, and EXPIRED_BEFORE_START that it expired before it could start the run (both: extend the job's expiration); EXPIRED_DURING_EXEC means the script expired during its run (extend the job's duration).

quotes: | Zscaler Internal Error | ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE_INTERNAL_ERR | There was an unexpected internal error. | No action required. |

| Workflow failed due to timeout during execution | ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT | The Remediation job reached its expiration and cannot run anymore. | Extend the Remediation job's expiration. |
| Workflow expired before it could start. | ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE_EXPIRED_BEFORE_START | The Remediation job expired before it could start the run. | Extend the Remediation job's expiration. |
| Workflow expired during execution. | ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE_EXPIRED_DURING_EXEC | The script expired during its run. | Extend the Remediation job's duration. |

abort-errors.statement: Workflow aborts: POLICY_ABORTED means an admin aborted the job (no action required); REM_DISABLED means the Remediation Settings were not enabled for the user or device; TASK_ABORTED means an admin aborted it or an overriding script run occurred (no action required); NOT_FOUND_ON_DEVICE is described as a failure because an admin aborted it (no action required).

quotes: | Workflow is aborted due to policy rules. | ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE_POLICY_ABORTED | The Remediation job was aborted by an admin. | No action required. |

| Workflow is aborted due to Remote Execution is disabled for the user/device. | ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE_REM_DISABLED | The Remediation job aborted because the Remediation Settings were not enabled for the user or device. |
| Task is aborted due to policy rules. | ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE_TASK_ABORTED | The Remediation job was aborted because an admin aborted it or there was an overriding script run. | No action required. |
| Workflow is skipped as it's not found on device. | ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE_NOT_FOUND_ON_DEVICE | The Remediation job failed because an admin aborted it. | No action required. |

task-errors.statement: Task and policy configuration errors: ABORTED_ON_TASK_ERR means the job aborted because of a task the device does not recognize or support; UNSUPPORTED_TASK_CATEGORY means an unsupported task category was received, the supported categories being SCRIPT and LOG_COLLECTION; POLICY_CONFIG_MISSING means the script is invalid due to removal or expired certification (upload the job with a valid certification); TASK_VALIDATION_ERR means the script contains an invalid task object, a null task, or an unsupported category; TASK_MAX_RETRY_REACHED means the job failed and reached the maximum number of retries (rerun the script when the user's device is available).

quotes: | Workflow is aborted due to task error. | ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE_ABORTED_ON_TASK_ERR | The Remediation job aborted because there is a task that the user's device does not recognize or support. |
| Workflow failed due to unsupported task category received. | ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE_UNSUPPORTED_TASK_CATEGORY |
The currently supported categories are SCRIPT and LOG_COLLECTION. |

| Workflow failed due to policy config for this workflow is not received. | ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE_POLICY_CONFIG_MISSING | The Remediation job aborted because the script is invalid due to removal or expired certification. | Upload the Remediation job with a valid certification. |
| Task validation failure. | ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE_TASK_VALIDATION_ERR | The script contains an invalid task object, a null task, or the category is not supported. |

| Task failed due to hitting maximum retry count limit. | ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE_TASK_MAX_RETRY_REACHED | The Remediation job failed and reached the maximum number of retries. | Rerun the script when the user's device is available. |

deferral-errors.statement: Deferral errors: USER_DEFERRED means the job was rescheduled; MAX_DEFER_REACHED is described as the job exceeding the maximum number of Remediation jobs; SCRIPT_RUN_USER_DEFERRED means the user postponed the job and SCRIPT_RUN_USER_DECLINED that the user declined it (no action required for these); LOG_FETCH_MAX_DEFER_REACHED means the job did not run because the maximum number of Remediation jobs was exceeded (wait for the other jobs to complete, then re-run it).

quotes: | Workflow rescheduled due to user deferral. | ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE_USER_DEFERRED | The Remediation job was rescheduled. | No action required. |
| Workflow failed due to hitting maximum defer count limit. | ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE_MAX_DEFER_REACHED | The Remediation job exceeded the maximum number of Remediation jobs. | No action required. |
| Script execution is deferred by user action. | ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE_SCRIPT_RUN_USER_DEFERRED | The user postponed the Remediation job. | No action required. |
| Script execution is declined by user action. | ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE_SCRIPT_RUN_USER_DECLINED | The user declined the Remediation job. | No action required. |

| Script execution failed due to hitting maximum defer count limit. | ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE_LOG_FETCH_MAX_DEFER_REACHED | The Remediation job did not run because you have exceeded the maximum number of Remediation jobs. | Wait to complete the other Remediation jobs and then re-run the job.

signature-errors.statement: Download and signature errors: SCRIPT_DOWNLOAD_FAILED means the script cannot be downloaded due to the network connection or an invalid URL (retry when the network connection is stable); SCRIPT_CERT_VALIDATION_FAILED labels both a message that the script's certification is unverified or missing (check the client's device for missing certificates) and one that the script's certificate cannot be verified (contact Zscaler Support); SCRIPT_INVALID_SIGNATURE means the digital signature is invalid (check the script's properties); SCRIPT_UNSIGNED means the script is not signed or the signature is invalid; SCRIPT_CERT_REVOKED means the certificate is revoked (check the revocation server is accessible and the OS is up to date, otherwise disable the revocation check).

quotes: | Failed to download script. | ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE_SCRIPT_DOWNLOAD_FAILED | The script cannot be downloaded due to the network connection or invalid URL. | Retry downloading when the network connection is stable. |

| Script certificate verification failure. | ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE_SCRIPT_CERT_VALIDATION_FAILED | The script's certification is unverified or missing. | Check the client's device to see if there are missing certificates. |
| Script signature validation failure. | ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE_SCRIPT_CERT_VALIDATION_FAILED | The script's certificate cannot be verified. | Contact Zscaler Support. |
| Script signature is invalid. | ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE_SCRIPT_INVALID_SIGNATURE | The script's digital signature is invalid. | Check the script's properties to validate the digital signature. |
| Script is unsigned. | ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE_SCRIPT_UNSIGNED | The script is not signed, or the signature is invalid. |
| Script certificate is revoked. | ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE_SCRIPT_CERT_REVOKED | The script certificate is revoked. |
Check if the revocation server is accessible and the OS is up-to-date. If these actions do not work, then disable the revocation check.

execution-errors.statement: Execution errors: SCRIPT_EXECUTION_POL_DISALLOWED and SCRIPT_EXECUTION_POL_SIGNED_ONLY mean the job is blocked by PowerShell's Execution Policy (both described as Restricted Mode); SCRIPT_TYPE_NOT_SUPPORTED means the job has an unsupported type; SCRIPT_UNKNOWN_RESULT means the script failed to run due to an unknown JSON response; SCRIPT_EXECUTION_ERR means runtime errors within the script (check and resolve them); SCRIPT_EXECUTION_TIMEDOUT means the defined timeout was hit (extend the job's runtime); SCRIPT_EXECUTION_ABORTED means an admin aborted the job; SCRIPT_HANDLER_INIT_FAILED means the job failed to initialize (contact Zscaler Support); SCRIPT_JOB_ID_NOT_FOUND means an invalid ID in the Client Connector Script Execution (SE) Platform; SCRIPT_ORCHESTRATOR_RPC_FAILURE means the Script Orchestrator Service is unavailable.

quotes: | Script execution blocked by execution policy: disallowed. | ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE_SCRIPT_EXECUTION_POL_DISALLOWED | The Remediation job is blocked due to Powershell Execution Policy's Restricted Mode. | No action required. |

| Script execution blocked by execution policy: only signed scripts are allowed. | ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE_SCRIPT_EXECUTION_POL_SIGNED_ONLY | The Remediation job is blocked due to PowerShell Execution Policy's Restricted Mode. | No action required. |
| Unsupported script type. | ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE_SCRIPT_TYPE_NOT_SUPPORTED | The Remediation job has an unsupported type. | No action required. |
| Script execution failed due to unknown result. | ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE_SCRIPT_UNKNOWN_RESULT | The script failed to run due to an unknown JSON response. | No action required. |

| Script execution error or exception occurred. | ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE_SCRIPT_EXECUTION_ERR | The script failed to run due to runtime errors within the script. | Check and resolve the runtime errors in the script. |
| Script execution failed due to timeout. | ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE_SCRIPT_EXECUTION_TIMEDOUT | The script failed to run due to the defined timeout. | Extend the runtime of the Remediation job.
| Script execution aborted. | ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE_SCRIPT_EXECUTION_ABORTED | The Remediation job was aborted by an admin. | No action required. |
| Script execution failed due to handler init failure. | ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE_SCRIPT_HANDLER_INIT_FAILED | The Remediation job failed to initialize. | Contact Zscaler Support |

| Script job ID not found in ZCC SE Platform. | ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE_SCRIPT_JOB_ID_NOT_FOUND | The Remediation job has an invalid ID in the Zscaler Client Connector Script Execution (SE) Platform. | No action required. |

| Script execution failed due to Script Orchestrator Service is not started or unavailable. | ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE_SCRIPT_ORCHESTRATOR_RPC_FAILURE | The Remediation job cannot run because of the unavailable Script Orchestrator Service. | No action required. |

log-notification-errors.statement: Log collection and notification errors: LOG_FETCH_ERR means logs could not be collected due to an internal error and LOG_FETCH_TIMEDOUT that the upload process exceeded its runtime (no action required for both); NOTIFICATION_INTERNAL_ERR, NOTIFICATION_SEND_FAILURE and NOTIFICATION_HANDLER_INIT_FAILED mean an internal error during notification, a failure to send it, and an error initializing the handler (contact Zscaler Support for all three); NOTIFICATION_NO_RESPONSE means the user's response timed out and NOTIFICATION_FRAMEWORK_DISABLED that the Zscaler Notification framework is disabled (no action required for both).

quotes: | Log collection error or exception occurred. | ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE_LOG_FETCH_ERR | Unable to collect data logs due to an internal error. | No action required. |
| Log collection failed due to timeout. | ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE_LOG_FETCH_TIMEDOUT | Unable to collect data logs because the upload process exceeds runtime. | No action required. |
| Internal error when handling notification. | ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE_NOTIFICATION_INTERNAL_ERR | An internal error occurred during notification. | Contact Zscaler Support. |
| Failed to send user notification. | ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE_NOTIFICATION_SEND_FAILURE | Unable to send user notification. | Contact Zscaler Support. |
| No response from the user. | ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE_NOTIFICATION_NO_RESPONSE | Unable to receive the user's response due to timeout. | No action required. |
| Notification handler init failure. | ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE_NOTIFICATION_HANDLER_INIT_FAILED | Unable to send notification due to error initializing. | Contact Zscaler Support. |

| Zscaler Notification Framework is disabled. | ZUPM_WORKFLOW_ECODE_NOTIFICATION_FRAMEWORK_DISABLED | Unable to send notification because Zscaler Notification framework is disabled. | No action required. |

table-anomalies.title: Rows of the Remediation Errors table that read inconsistently
table-anomalies.detail: As published: two messages share the reason SCRIPT_CERT_VALIDATION_FAILED; NOT_FOUND_ON_DEVICE (message: workflow skipped as not found on device) is described as failing because an admin aborted it; MAX_DEFER_REACHED and LOG_FETCH_MAX_DEFER_REACHED, named for a defer count, are described as exceeding the maximum number of Remediation jobs; both execution-policy errors are described as Restricted Mode, including the one named for signed-only scripts. No source says which wording is intended.
table-anomalies.blocks: reading a reason code as meaning exactly what its description says
